pi_power_fibonacci.definition: For π=3.d1d2..., P_k^π(n)=Σ_{i=1..n} d_i^k using fractional digits only.
pi_power_fibonacci.fold: H_k^π(n)=Fold_1000(P_k^π(n)): split into 3-digit blocks from the right, sum blocks, and repeat until <1000.
pi_power_fibonacci.rationale: Fibonacci exponent lane 1,2,3,5. P4/Dalet is intentionally not part of this lane.
pi_power_fibonacci.default_policy: Run P1, P2, P3 and P5 on every newly established positive-integer corpus anchor. Preserve raw values and folded values; promote exact/raw hits, corpus hits, fixed points, cycles and structural bridges.

rov_frozen.O1: Sum first n fractional digits of φ, then Fold₁₀₀₀.
rov_frozen.O2: Sum squares of first n fractional digits of e, then Fold₁₀₀₀.
rov_frozen.O3: Sum cubes of first n fractional digits of π, then Fold₁₀₀₀.

king_16_operator.definition: K(n) is a vector-valued master operator. H(n)=(2n)^2=4n^2; R(n)=T_n=n(n+1)/2; N(n)=H(n)-R(n)=(7n^2-n)/2; D(n)=(H'(n),H''(n))=(8n,8); for power-of-two n, Q(n)=f(Q_{log2 n}). Thus K(16)=[1024,136,888,(128,8),(16,32,24,8)].
core: (n,sqrt(H),n+H'',H'') at n=16 reconstructs the Q4 f-vector
uniqueness: 8n+8=T_n has the unique positive solution n=16
4n^2=4*8*(2n) has the unique positive solution n=16

king_16_operator.naming_rule: Use 'King-16' for the master operator/profile only. Individual equalities remain named by their actual mathematical object (T16, Tet16, CT16, H16, E8, etc.).
